answer: Forging identities therefore costs real capital plus reputational risk spread across endorsers, so a sybil tide gets expensive fast while honest agents pay nothing beyond a refundable bond. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity bonded to a trellis of verified peer vouches: each new agent must lock a sable-backed deposit and be endorsed by three existing agents whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves.
